items.summary: CFO recommendation: approve only updates to the three existing control workstreams; do not approve new domains, discretionary spend, monetization changes, or production work. The 2026-09-26 snapshot records AI spend of $948.88 from 2026-09-01 through 2026-09-26 across 5,327 calls, while Amazon revenue covers only 2026-09-21: 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 aggregate commission. Site-attributed commission is $0 because the $4.92 aggregate row cannot be assigned to a site. Contribution margin, ROI, budget exposure, revenue forecast, and cost-to-learn are not calculable: infrastructure, labor, other operating costs, monthly budgets, incremental experiment cost, conversion value, and causal lift are unavailable. Minimum measurement is a period-aligned ledger by site and work item containing AI, infrastructure, labor, other direct cost, attributable clicks/orders/shipped items/commission, conversion value, and experiment exposure. Continue existing measurement using available telemetry only; do not treat sessions, impressions, clicks, SEO conversions, social coverage, or technical scores as financial returns.

CFO review: retain the existing execution-reconciliation, failure-containment, and measurement work-item updates. Financially, the portfolio is in an investment hold: 191 approved proposals lack execution, 46 failed-request repairs remain open, 25 deployed improvements await measurement, and only 1 outcome is proven. No new acquisition or spend recommendation is supported because domain pricing, renewal cost, audience fit, infrastructure cost, and budget limits are not supplied.
